Everything we do at Trinity is underpinned by our vision and values. We believe that children who attend Trinity First School will have the opportunity to grow as individuals in a happy and secure environment.
​​​​​​​Trinity
At Trinity, the children always come first and we strive to provide the best in terms of education as well as being a supportive community. Everything we do at Trinity is underpinned by our aims and values. We believe that children who attend Trinity First School will have the opportunity to grow as individuals in a happy and secure environment.

Latest News
Follow Us
A wonderful group of children will move on from Trinity, at the end of today. Over the years they have always been lots of fun - we are proud of each of them, who are all ready for what comes next! Have a great summer! Keep in touch! Go Well.
Well that was lots of fun! Our thanks to all who contributed back and front of house for the Year 4 Production of Mary Poppins! A huge well done to the children, who sang, acted and stage managed! A performance to warm hearts.
Last week, some children from Year 1 and Year 3 spent a wonderful day at the beach. They worked together to complete some artwork and also had a lovely time together enjoying our beautiful coastline!
The Year 4 - Mary Poppins Dress Rehearsal went well today... all of those with a ticket for Tuesday and Wednesday are in for a treat....!
Thank you to our school community who helped make our annual Summer Fayre, such a success. We are indebted to Hannah, Jax, Kristy and the rest of the PTA Links team, who do so much behind the scenes. Thanks also to those who volunteered on stalls and contrinuted to prizes and donations. Also to our families, who give so much to help make our school such a great place! In terms of money raised, the final figures will be announced soon, along with what we intend to spend this on. Again - huge thanks! Everyone seemed to have a great time, in the sun!
What a wonderful day we had on Friday during Sports Day! A real highlight of the calendar for all of the children, families and staff in our community. A real coming together. Some fun races, like the sack race and pizza delivery races. Some races taken a little more seriously, like the sprints and the parents shuttle relay... All of the races were cheered and all races led to smiles! An occasion to warm hearts!
Lots to do here....!
Our Year 4 children are back from the amazing PGL Osmington Bay A great time had by all, thanks for all who made it possible! Some wonderful memories...
Our Year 3 children have recently been writing for purpose. A very famous 100 year old, David Attenborough has 30 letters to read this June! We will let you know if he replies...
Our thanks to Izzie and David from RNLI who joined us in school today, to help our Year 2, 3 and Year 4 children learn about how to keep themselves safe at the beach and in open water. Really important, where we are located and also at this time of year. https://rnli.org/

The Diocese of Salisbury Academy Trust Leavers Service at Salisbury Cathedral is always a lovely occassion. A great chnace to be together, as one.
Our Year 4 children had a great time this week dodging the showers on their bikes and learning to stay safe on the roads of Verwood. Thank you to Nicola from Bikeability for her guidance and patience, also to our volunteers who helped make it happen! #bikeability

Wraparound Care
Orchard Explorers is the after school care run by Orchard Day Nursery. The club is available Monday to Friday until 6pm. For futher information please contact them on 01202 820124.

Governance
A warm welcome from the Academy Standards and Ethos Committee (ASEC).
We are proud to support our school as part of the Diocese of Salisbury Academy Trust. Working alongside school leaders, the ASEC helps ensure every child receives a high-quality education in a safe, caring and inclusive environment. We provide strategic challenge and support, monitor the school's progress and wellbeing, and promote its Christian vision and values. Our governors are volunteers drawn from the local community who are committed to helping the school flourish. We value the partnership between families, staff and governors and look forward to supporting the continued success of our school.
"The Academy Standards and Ethos Committee is made up of governors who follow the DSAT Scheme of Delegation. Full details of governance in the Trust can be found by clicking here.
DSAT Scheme of Delegation
We are members of the Diocese of Salisbury Academy Trust and the governance of the Trust belongs to the main DSAT Board. Our Scheme of Delegation also includes our Constitution and Terms of Reference. Paper copies can be obtained through the school office or by using the contact us option on this website. You can find details of the Trust Board and details of our Trust Governance by visiting the Trustees page,
Register of Interests
Governor Meeting Attendance
A copy of governors’ meeting minutes can be made available by request from the clerk via office@trinityverwood.dsat.org.uk Please note charges may apply, more information can be found in the DSAT Publication Scheme available via: https://www.dsat.org.uk/others/.

SEND
At Trinity we acknowledge children’s individuality in learning, both in the way that they learn and in the speed they learn. We are committed to providing excellent experiences that cater for each and every child.
Some children will require extra individual or small group help and may require an Individual Education Plan (IEP). These are written by the class teacher and contain small, personalised, achievable targets. The children's progress towards these targets is shared with the parents half termly.
Our Special Educational Needs Co-ordinator (SENDCO) is Mrs Rebecca Peckham
